name: MynaUI
summary: Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui UI kit: 346 React components plus a matching Figma kit and open-source icon set.
description: Copy-paste React components built with Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI and shadcn/ui, installed through the shadcn CLI registry. Organised into elements, forms, marketing and application pieces, each shipping as Figma and code, plus a design-token reference (colors, type, spacing, shadows) and the open-source MynaUI Icons set.
contains: 346 components and blocks in the shadcn registry
every entry ships as Figma and code
install via shadcn CLI namespace or copy the code
design system page: colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, blur
MynaUI Icons: React, SVG sprites, icon font, Figma file and plugin
